## 1. Acceptance test — highest risk first

Never driven by me. I ran the unit suites and confirmed the module loads; I did
not open the UI.

| # | What | Why it is risky |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | **Merged Asset Renamer** — ribbon icon, modal, both bulk tools, Configure sources | ~600 lines moved wholesale, zero UI runs. Rollback: re-enable `asset-renamer` in Settings → Community plugins; its folder is intact |
| 2 | **Bases formulas** — `image(cover.path)` and `home_size: home.size` in `data/base/*.base` | No `formulas:` example existed in the vault to check syntax against. Taken from your own spelling in README item 9. Wrong syntax shows a column error, not a broken view |
| 3 | **Clean orphaned configs** — 01/Registry button and command | New modal, never rendered |
| 4 | **⤓ implement button** — 02/Definition, before the × | New modal, never rendered |
| 5 | **Field rename** moves its config note; **schema rename** moves the folder | Only the pure plan is tested, not the file operations |

Reproduction for 5: rename `trait` → `feature` in LifeForm's 02/Definition.
Expect `data/config/LifeForm/trait.md` to become `feature.md` with
`configFor: [LifeForm.feature]`, and exactly one note in that folder.

## 2. Decisions waiting on you

- **Item 9 column.** The `image()` formula **replaces** the raw attachment
  column rather than sitting beside it, so the link text is no longer visible in
  the table. My call, not yours. One line to change if you want both.
- **R1 collision warning.** `data/config/Realm/Realm.md` has the basename
  `Realm`. Generated links are always path-qualified so they are safe, but a
  hand-typed `[[Realm]]` resolves to the value list. A sync-time warning was
  proposed in the spec and deliberately **not** built — it was scope you had not
  agreed to.
- **Delete `.obsidian/plugins/asset-renamer/`?** Kept on disk as the rollback for
  the merge. Remove it once the merge passes acceptance.
- **Push.** You asked me not to. `git push` when ready.

## 3. The branch model is half-built

Item 5 shipped the rules but **no `data/<project>` branch exists yet** — only
`main` and `feature/db-schema-sync`. To create the first one:

```bash
git checkout -b data/myproject
# remove the /data/ line from .gitignore on THIS branch only
git add -f data/
git commit -m "Track vault data on this branch"
```

`.githooks/pre-push` refuses any push of `data/` files to `main` or `feature/*`.
It is enabled here (`core.hooksPath=.githooks`) but that is local config — run
`git config core.hooksPath .githooks` once per clone.

Note `data/` is currently **untracked** on this branch. The files are untouched
on disk; they are simply no longer in git here. That is the intended end state.

## 4. Known gaps, carried forward

- A schema renamed while one of its fields is unbound leaves that field's config
  note with a stale `configFor`, and the orphan rule will flag it. The cleanup is
  manual and shows its reasoning, so a false positive is visible.
- `isRecordFile()` still treats `config/entity.md` as a record for backwards
  compatibility, though nothing generates it any more.
